page.title: Lower Your Prescription Costs | AltaMedicare
page.description: Free prescription review for Utah Medicare beneficiaries. We compare your medications across Part D plans and pharmacies to find your lowest cost.

header.ledeHtml: Send us your medication list and we’ll review whether your current plan is your most affordable option. No cost. No obligation.

why.h2: Why Most People Overpay for Prescriptions
why.intro: The same medication can cost wildly different amounts depending on:
itemsHtml: Which Part D plan you have — each plan covers different drugs at different copay tiers
Which pharmacy you use — preferred pharmacies often cost dramatically less than standard ones
Whether you use mail order — 90-day supplies are often cheaper than three monthly fills
Whether you qualify for Extra Help — many people qualify and don’t know it
Whether the new $2,000 cap applies to you — this 2025+ change affects high-cost drug users
why.outroHtml: People often switch into the same plan year after year out of habit. We’ll actually compare your options, not just renew you into what you had.

review.introHtml: Tell us what you take and we’ll get back to you with a personalized cost comparison.
